runtimeDescription: One real Wizard snapshot-harness sanity run against local Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, MCP and Go gateway services, with live provider inference.
credentialMode: The real flow used a local wizard-app OAuth token with the application’s full scope ceiling. A fresh token from the exact wizard_ci_token command has only llm_gateway:read and still returns HTTP 403 on project reads; this smoke does not establish deployed CI compatibility.
contextRouting: Verified in this run: skill menu and integration skill ZIP loaded from http://localhost:8765; MCP used http://localhost:8787/mcp and PostHog used http://localhost:8010.
localOverrides: Snapshot harness captures observed gateway model completions and UI transitions, initializes local routing, and authenticates against the local API.
The local capture harness stops after five successful model completions; full integration completion is outside this sanity run.
Local fixtures enabled gateway rollout, allowed 100 mints per day, and set a $30 team gateway overspend allowance.
The run used the chart-defined new-tier scoped-token cap of $6; the local team wallet was funded for provider dispatch.
